head_commit.message:
perf(tui2): reduce unnecessary redraws (#8681)

This reduces unnecessary frame scheduling in codex-tui2.

Changes:
- Gate redraw scheduling for streaming deltas when nothing visible
changes.
- Avoid a redraw feedback loop from footer transcript UI state updates.

Why:
- Streaming deltas can arrive at very high frequency; redrawing on every
delta can drive a near-constant render loop.
- BottomPane was requesting another frame after every Draw even when the
derived transcript UI state was unchanged.

Testing:
- cargo test -p codex-tui2

Manual sampling:
- sample "$(pgrep -n codex-tui2)" 3 -file
/tmp/tui2.idle.after.sample.txt
- sample "$(pgrep -n codex-tui2)" 3 -file
/tmp/tui2.streaming.after.sample.txt

head_commit.message:
perf(tui2): avoid redraw loop from transcript ui state

App publishes derived transcript viewport state to the footer after every
draw. BottomPane was unconditionally scheduling another frame when
receiving that state, even when nothing changed.

This created a self-sustaining redraw loop (clamped by FrameRequester)
and burned CPU while visually idle.

Only request a redraw when the derived transcript UI state
(scrolled/selection/position/copy key) actually changes.

head_commit.message:
perf(tui2): reduce unnecessary redraws (#8681)

This reduces unnecessary frame scheduling in codex-tui2.

Changes:
- Gate redraw scheduling for streaming deltas when nothing visible
changes.
- Avoid a redraw feedback loop from footer transcript UI state updates.

Why:
- Streaming deltas can arrive at very high frequency; redrawing on every
delta can drive a near-constant render loop.
- BottomPane was requesting another frame after every Draw even when the
derived transcript UI state was unchanged.

Testing:
- cargo test -p codex-tui2

Manual sampling:
- sample "$(pgrep -n codex-tui2)" 3 -file
/tmp/tui2.idle.after.sample.txt
- sample "$(pgrep -n codex-tui2)" 3 -file
/tmp/tui2.streaming.after.sample.txt

head_commit.message:
Build Phase 1: Complete LMU Curriculum Runtime foundation

Implement full Celaya Solutions LMU (Language Model Unit)
curriculum runtime infrastructure per CODEX.md specification.

## Architecture Added

celaya/
├── CELAYA.md - Mission, LMU definition, CUDA analogy
├── README.md - Quick start and architecture overview
└── lmu/
    ├── syllabus/
    │   ├── syllabus.yaml - 6 lessons with dependencies
    │   └── phases.md - Human-readable curriculum guide
    ├── generator/
    │   ├── pipeline.py - Lesson orchestration
    │   ├── prompts.py - All prompt templates (no inline)
    │   ├── extract.py - Defensive JSON parsing
    │   └── validators.py - Schema and contract validation
    ├── runtime/
    │   ├── receipts.py - JSONL event writer
    │   └── runner.py - Named operations with timing
    ├── grading/
    │   ├── weights.json - Per-lesson artifact weights
    │   └── grader.py - Partial credit calculation
    └── artifacts/
        └── .gitkeep

run.py - Main entry point for curriculum generation

## Core Features

- Local-first execution (Ollama default)
- Defensive parsing (model output = untrusted input)
- Receipt-driven observability (JSONL events)
- Partial credit grading (missing artifacts = 0, not errors)
- Fault tolerance (continue on errors)
- CUDA analogy enforcement (kernel = LMU op)
- No hype language validation
- Retry with constraint tightening

## Curriculum Structure

6 lessons across 4 phases:
- Foundations (0.1-0.2): LMU execution model, defensive parsing
- Runtime (1.0-1.1): Receipts, retry logic
- Evaluation (2.0): Partial credit grading
- Optimization (advanced.1): Parallel execution

## Usage

python run.py                    # Generate full curriculum
python run.py --check            # Verify Ollama
python run.py --lessons 0.1,0.2  # Generate specific lessons
python run.py --phase foundations # Generate phase
python run.py --grade            # Grade curriculum

## Compliance

✓ Celaya Solutions identity and headers on all files
✓ LMU execution model with explicit CUDA analogy
✓ Deterministic runtime behavior
✓ Receipts for every operation
✓ Partial success over total failure
✓ No crashes on malformed output
✓ Structured as specified in CODEX.md

Ready for Ollama integration and lesson generation in Phase 2.
